transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. I guess... well, I plan events for work, so I have to be in front of people a lot more lately. And... I don't know, I just can't stop staring at this one part of my face in photos. It looks really uneven. People tell me they barely see anything, but... yeah. That's kind of why I'm here.
Is it always this one part of your face that bothers you, or do you find yourself worrying about other parts of your body as well?
Um... mostly just my face. I guess I don't really think about the rest of it that much. Just... just the one part, really.
Do you find it hard to stop thinking about this part of your face even when you're trying to focus on something else?
Um... I'm not really sure. I try to just focus on my work when I'm setting things up, so... I don't know if I've really noticed it like that. I just try to keep busy.
Has worrying about this part of your face interfered with your daily life or relationships in any way?

Um... I guess a little bit. It's just... I missed part of a deadline recently. I was supposed to have some event materials ready, but I just... I spent too much time looking at the photos they wanted to use of me, trying to fix how I looked. And now... I don't know, it just takes me longer to get ready for vendor calls and meeting prep than it probably should.
Do you think this part of your face is actually uneven, or is it just that you wish it looked different?
Um... I don't know. I mean, it looks uneven to me. I just... I can see it. So I don't think it's just wishing it was different. It just is.
Do you think it would be possible for this part of your face to look okay to you, or do you feel like it's always going to be a problem?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't... I haven't really thought about it like that. I just know how it looks to me right now. So... yeah, I'm not sure.
Do you think there's anything that could be done to fix this part of your face that bothers you?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't... I haven't really looked into anything specific. I just... I don't really know what would fix it.
Do you think that even if someone else, like a doctor or a plastic surgeon, told you that this part of your face looks normal, you would still be worried about it?

Um... I don't really know. I guess... probably? I mean, I can still see it, so... I don't know if someone just telling me it's normal would actually make me stop worrying. But... yeah, it's hard to say.
Do you think that if this part of your face was changed to look exactly how you want it to, you would no longer be worried about it?
I mean... maybe? I guess if it was exactly how I wanted... I wouldn't have to think about it as much. But... I don't know for sure.
Do you worry that other people are noticing this part of your face?
Um... yeah, I guess. I mean, I try not to think about it too much, but... yeah, sometimes I wonder if people are looking. It's just... hard to tell.
Do you think that other people can see the unevenness in your face that you're worried about?

Um... yeah. I mean, I guess that's why I'm here. I... I plan events for work, so I have to be in front of people a lot more now. And... I just can't stop staring at it in photos. It just looks so uneven to me. Even when people tell me they barely see anything, I just... I feel like they have to be noticing it.
Do you think that your view of this part of your face is possibly not accurate?
I don't know. I mean... I see what I see in the mirror. I don't think my eyes are making it up.
Do you think you would still be worried about this part of your face if you were completely alone and never saw yourself in photos or mirrors?
I mean... I guess I wouldn't think about it as much if I never had to see it. But... I don't know. It's hard to imagine.
Do you think you worry more about how this part of your face looks to you or about what others might think of it
Um... I'm not really sure. Probably both, I guess. It bothers me when I look at it, but... I also worry about people noticing it at work. I don't really know which is worse.
Do you think that if nobody else ever commented on or noticed this part of your face, you would still be as worried about it?
I... I don't know. Maybe. It's just hard to say.
Do you think you would still be worried about this part of your face if you were certain that nobody else noticed it or thought it was unusual?
Um... I really don't know. It's... kind of hard to imagine that happening, so... yeah, I'm just not sure. I can't really separate it all in my head.
Is your worry about this part of your face more about how it looks to you or about what others might think of you?
Um... I don't really know what else to tell you. It's... like I said before, it's just both. I can't really pick one over the other.
Do you feel compelled to perform any specific rituals or behaviors to try to fix or check on the part of your face that bothers you?

I guess so. Um... yeah, I do. Like... before I send out pictures from an event, or if I have to get on a video call with a vendor, I'll... I'll check my phone camera a lot. Just to see. And I'll retake pictures, or try to hold my head at a certain angle so it doesn't look as bad. Sometimes I ask a coworker if I look weird. It... it takes up a lot of time, honestly. Sometimes I get behind on my planning because of it.
Do you think you would still check and retake pictures as frequently if you were certain that nobody else was going to see them?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess... I haven't really thought about it like that. I don't usually take pictures just for myself, so... yeah, I just don't know.
Do you think your checking and retaking of pictures is more to make sure you look acceptable to yourself or to avoid what others might think of your appearance?
Um... I don't really know. It's kind of like what I said before... it's just both, I guess. I don't really separate it like that in my head. I just... I just don't want to look bad.
